title: Read Binary File
text: Read image from file location, 4 outputs, {Output data type} sets Data type of output; {File name} sets the input image, {Sample time}, {Image signal} sets the signal returned by block One multidimensional, {Output port labels}, {Signed}, {Word length} sets the bits in fixed-point data type, {Set fraction length in output to} sets the scaling factor of fixed-point data type, {Fractional length} sets the fractional bits and {User-defined data type} sets the user-defined fixed-point data type uint. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: R
ports.summary: Red color component of image matrix

ports.name: G
ports.summary: Green color component of image matrix

ports.name: B
ports.summary: Blue color component of image matrix

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time for block execution inf (default) | Positive scalar | Vector

params.name: Image signal
params.values: Signal returned by block One multidimensional signal (default) | Separate color signals

params.name: Output port labels
params.values: Output port labels R|G|B (default) | port names

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of output image inherit from input image (default) | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean | fixed-point | user-defined | inherit via back propagation

params.name: Signed
params.values: Signed fixed-point data type on (default) | off

params.name: Word length
params.values: Bits in fixed-point data type 16 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Set fraction length in output to
params.values: Scaling factor of fixed-point data type User-defined (default) | Best precision

params.name: User-defined data type
params.values: User-defined fixed-point data type uint(8) (default) | User-defined fixed-point data type
